topic: A phone call comes from a number that is not in service, and the caller knows Saad's name.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Disconnected Caller

shots.narration: Last night, a disconnected station phone called your mobile, Saad.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look, courtyard of an old Pakistani haveli at night, brass lantern between two stools, no text.
shots.action: Bashir points toward Saad's mobile beside the lantern.
shots.mood: Amber lantern glow, deep blue shadows, thin ground fog.

shots.narration: Let me tell you what happened after you went inside.
shots.scene: Haveli courtyard, Bashir in a brown woollen shawl and white cap opposite Saad in a dark green hoodie, no text.
shots.action: Bashir leans toward Saad across the lantern.
shots.mood: Grey beard lit from below, empty darkness behind both stools.

shots.narration: [whispers] You entered the abandoned station to escape the rain.
shots.scene: Previous night, abandoned fictional Pakistani railway station, blank walls, empty platform, rain beyond the doorway, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Saad steps into the waiting room with his small torch.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, wet floor reflections, heavy deserted silence.

shots.narration: Your mobile rang beside an old station telephone.
shots.scene: Dusty station waiting room, old black telephone on a wooden desk, mobile screen dark and unmarked.
shots.action: Saad lifts his vibrating mobile from his hoodie pocket.
shots.mood: Torchlight catches dust, black window panes, muted blue shadows.

shots.narration: The caller said your name before you spoke.
shots.scene: Close view inside the abandoned waiting room, old telephone blurred behind Saad, no visible writing.
shots.action: Saad holds the mobile against his ear.
shots.mood: Tense eyes, narrow torch glow across his face.

shots.narration: [surprised] Calling back only gave you the number-not-in-service message.
shots.scene: Station desk beside a rain-streaked window, mobile facing away from the camera, no text.
shots.action: Saad presses the mobile to his ear again.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, cold window light, darkness beneath the desk.

shots.scene: Close view of the old black telephone on the dusty wooden station desk, blank dial center, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: The telephone trembles against the dusty desktop.
shots.mood: Hard moonlight outlines the receiver, surrounding room nearly black.

shots.narration: You reached for it, but stopped.
shots.scene: Abandoned waiting room, old telephone at the desk edge, Saad's torch aimed downward.
shots.action: Saad extends one hesitant hand toward the receiver.
shots.mood: Long crooked shadows, suspended dust, tight fearful expression.

shots.narration: [whispers] Its cable ended in a broken plug.
shots.scene: Under the station desk, telephone cable trailing from above to a visibly snapped plug on dusty floorboards, no text.
shots.action: A torch beam reveals the broken plug.
shots.mood: Sharp white light inside deep darkness, undisturbed dust.

shots.narration: You backed away, keeping both hands where you could see them.
shots.scene: Wide waiting-room view, telephone on desk, doorway behind Saad, mobile and torch visible in his separate hands.
shots.action: Saad takes one backward step from the desk.
shots.mood: Empty space around him, looming desk shadow, pale rainlight.

shots.narration: The receiver rose by itself and whispered your name again.
shots.scene: Abandoned station waiting room, receiver suspended between its empty cradle and Saad's face, both his occupied hands visible.
shots.action: The receiver floats toward Saad's ear.
shots.mood: Extreme dread, wide eyes, receiver casting a huge shadow across his cheek.

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, I'll explain why your locked house is calling now.
shots.scene: Present night in the haveli courtyard, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad, mobile face down on a stool, no text.
shots.action: Saad's mobile vibrates beside the lantern.
shots.mood: Warm lantern surrounded by dense darkness, both faces frozen in alarm.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow: a call from inside Saad's locked house.
episode.description: By his lantern, Bashir Chacha tells Saad a story about the abandoned station he visited last night. A disconnected phone knew his name—and the call isn't over. A fictional spooky tale from Midnight Watch.
